entities.summary: The Staatsschauspiel Dresden is a theatre in Dresden. It is maintained by the Free State of Saxony, hence its name. It consists of a main auditorium, the Schauspielhaus, and a studio theatre, the Kleine Haus. It was created in 1983 and housed in the old Staatstheater Dresden which traced back to a Royal Court Theatre. Staatsschauspiel Dresden is a theatre building in Europe, established in 1911. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
